caption: The drawing consists of a horizontal band featuring a repeating scrollwork pattern. The scrollwork is composed of curved and flowing shapes reminiscent of acanthus leaves or vines, depicted in a light color against a dark shaded background. The band is bordered by two pairs of parallel lines, one pair above and one pair below the scrollwork. The drawing is on a plain off-white background, and in the lower left corner, the text "USS. Hartford" is written, while the lower right corner reads "Open Scroll Work." The overall composition is symmetrical, with the scroll pattern regularly alternating along the horizontal axis.
title: Scroll Work
